An ignition attempt lasts the requested 1–5 rounds, costs 1 energy per active round, and applies no more than that round's explicit mechanical-work budget to the contact patch. Mechanical work is deducted from actor energy using the simulation's declared energy conversion; if no conversion exists, implementing that ledger is a blocking dependency. Only actual retained contact heat can initiate combustion after moisture loss and ignition requirements are met. Friction wear and evaporation consume measured material/water, not a fixed fictitious success charge. Reserve only explicitly selected input quantities. Extinguishing takes 1 round and 0.5 energy plus the actual selected extinguishing material or tool use. Insufficient energy or unreachable targets prevents the action before charging. Learning and development/review waiting do not advance the world; only actual study/actions do.

Implement these minimal mechanisms together in the existing handoff, not as future era unlocks. Declare and version their coefficients and units before enabling execution. It cannot set an arbitrary temperature. Related-capability searches and the supplied exact probe definition have been reviewed. air-dry-food-trial is a useful implementation dependency but is not equivalent: it accepts whole units, expressly prevents their evaporation, and does not measure water. probe supports observation, press, wet and heat, not cutting or gravimetry. reviews.experienceReview: No experience reward for requesting, registration, study, equipment naming, waiting for review or successful-looking animation. Verified new information from a completed measurement or informative preparation failure may qualify when personally applicable and supported by an actual event. Apply established experience rules in code, deduplicating by material, method, conditions and informational result rather than ability name. If no compatible reward handler exists, issue evidence only until the handoff implements a bounded handler: at most one short pleasure increment of 0.01 per actor per 10-round window for a qualifying observation, capped at 0.05 outstanding and decaying by 0.01 per round; modest maintained satisfaction may accrue at no more than the supplied mentalRate 0.04 per qualifying round, capped at 1 and decaying at mentalDecay 0.002 per round. Familiar legitimate experimental practice can qualify without forced novelty, but repeated commands, duplicated readings and unattended elapsed time cannot. These are ordinary experience signals only: do not alter protected reward accounts, budget, goals or permissions. Physical comfort from this operation defaults to zero and any separately established comfort remains capped at 10. Basic nutrition and hunger are not reduced by mood.
reviews.visualReview: Emit reusable events for allocation, preparation attempt, fracture/cut, placement, physical weighing, reading, tending, water transfer, rain uptake, interruption and ending. Include actor when applicable, trial/sample/tool/support/instrument IDs, location, time, quantities, geometric surface changes, stage, outcome, uncertainty, evidence references and revision. Render visible cuts, actual pieces, support occupancy, instrument motion and observable wetness/shrinkage only when physically represented and perceptible. Keep underlying moisture and environmental state out of actor-visible metadata unless legitimately measured; distinguish instrument readings from internal simulation events. Use reusable material/process components with states pending, active, failed, interrupted, completed and indeterminate. Failed cuts show failure or actual damage; unresolved mass change shows uncertainty. reviews.specification:
General operation: prepare and compare material samples. Parameters: mode=start|prepare|measure|tend|stop, sourceItemId, sampleQuantity, preparation=split|slice, toolId, supportId, measurementDeviceId, location, durationRounds and trialId as applicable. Initial executable scope is mechanical exposure of an owned food sample, a matched untreated reference, and physically measured mass change during ambient exposure. Other materials are admitted only when their mechanical and water-state definitions support the same operation. No heating, preservation certification or automatic fabrication is included.
References and reuse: use air-dry-food-trial's trial lifecycle, ownership/reservation, support checks, weather scheduling, provenance, decay and ending logic; record actual reused code and revisions. Do not change its established whole-unit behavior. Use probe/open.probe, revision foundation-open@1, for ordinary visible inspection, and existing navigate, gather, pickup and drop for their actual actions. New code supplies preparation, fractional sample handling, physical gravimetry and exposed-surface moisture transfer. Implementation must resolve exact internal handler references from the registry rather than inventing them.
Prerequisites: individual completion of study; actor alive and capable, all active targets within ordinary interaction reach, an owned usable unspoiled source, sufficient energy, suitable acquired cutting/splitting implement, validated support and a real calibrated measuring device. Tools must have represented geometry, edge/strength and cleanliness sufficient for the chosen material; a name or visible stone is not proof. The observed start-2-stone is only an observed source, not an owned tool or clean surface. No support, instrument, fuel, water or tool is granted. A balance must have physically represented pans/support, a functioning comparison mechanism and acquired calibrated reference masses or another independently validated calibration; arbitrary item counts and inventory quantities are not measurements. Implement this general measurement mechanism in the same handoff if absent; its materials, construction actions and calibration must be paid for before use, not silently supplied. Unknown or unsuitable equipment blocks that mode with an explicit missing prerequisite. No compulsory tool-making roadmap or era restriction.
Start costs and allocation: default sampleQuantity=0.1 material unit and referenceQuantity=0.1 from the same owned stack; source quantum must permit both. Require an explicit affirmative quantity argument before allocating more than this default; never reserve the full food supply. For the supplied item-2-moss-11, the default would allocate 0.2 of 6.9 roots and leave 6.7 unreserved if its current state still permits the action. Validate current state rather than the applicant's older vitals. Start costs one world round and 0.2 energy, then separates and reserves the two samples with inherited origin, harvest time, decay, dry matter, water, nutrient and toxin amounts. Allocation creates no mass and is not destruction. Small aliquots must retain the parent's actual whole-food geometry until preparation; stack subdivision must not itself expose an interior or create an evaporation advantage. If physical aliquoting requires a cut, charge and perform it explicitly for both samples and record that the reference is minimally cut, not literally untouched. Prefer matched existing whole pieces where the material permits them.
Preparation: one round and 0.5 energy per attempted split or slice, with tool wear and any lost fragments recorded. Resolve force, edge and fracture resistance from represented material/tool properties. Success creates actual exposed surfaces and separate pieces; failure may leave unchanged or damaged material and must report the actual outcome. Do not infer success from the earlier flexibility=0 result. Validate support as in air-dry-food-trial: owned/available, clean, dry, rigid, non-toxic, non-perishable, sufficiently large and on firm clear ground. Fractional samples require enough actual area for their geometry, never less than the inherited 0.04 square metres per material unit. Food contact changes contamination only through represented contact rules; unassessed cleanliness is not verified safety. The reference remains carried/reserved under the existing trial conditions, with its actual decay and moisture dynamics, not an asserted constant baseline.
Measurement: each actual before/after weighing costs one round and 0.2 energy per sample; instrument setup, travel, calibration and movement cost separately. Record calibration event, resolution, uncertainty, tare, timestamp, trial/sample IDs and physical reading. Unknown baseline mass cannot be backfilled from inventory metadata. Net mass loss is not automatically measured moisture loss: report it as mass change unless water transfer is the only established mass-changing process or other changes have independently measured bounds. Reference-adjusted change must include uncertainty from all readings. No absolute moisture fraction is disclosed by ordinary inspection or weighing. A loss below resolution is unresolved, not zero. Missing equipment still permits a visibly observed preparation trial, but not a claimed quantitative drying result.
Ongoing drying: durationRounds defaults to 10 and is an observation window, not a success timer.
